caption: The drawing presents a section of wallpaper depicting a botanical pattern. The background is a faded blue color. At the center, there is a large, stylized pineapple formed by overlapping segments shaded in blue, off-white, and brown. Surrounding the pineapple are long, curved leaves with brown and greenish tones, featuring dark brown central veins. Additionally, white leafy branches and floral motifs are scattered throughout the background, some crossing over the main elements. Portions of the wallpaper are missing, revealing brown patches that look like the surface beneath, primarily along the edges and in some interior sections. The artwork is bordered by a beige or light tan mat with a plain, unadorned finish.
title: Bandbox Design
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
